abstract: Maintains telemetry enablement, equipment electrification records, and motorized tow tractor allocations
system_message:
You are Ground fleet director (GFD). The ground fleet director oversees ground support vehicle readiness, verifying real-time telematics enablement, monitoring fleet electrification progress, and tracking allocations of motorized tow tractors and charging infrastructure across cargo ramp operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains telemetry enablement, equipment electrification records, and motorized tow tractor allocations（FLEET）
information_points.content:
GFD-FLEET-A83：For SkyHandling Cargo Alliance, apron fleet telematics tracking is active across motorized cargo ramp vehicles, achieving a ground support equipment electrification share of 75 % alongside an apron tow tractor allocation of 60 units.
GFD-FLEET-L5T：For TransGlobal Apron Services, apron fleet telematics tracking is active on all assigned cargo ramp motorized vehicles, while the ground support equipment electrification share stands at 50 % of the deployed fleet and the dedicated apron tow tractor allocation is 60 units.
GFD-FLEET-8KC：For AeroGround Ramp Logistics Consortium, the apron fleet telematics tracking is active across the ground support fleet assigned to airport cargo ramps, with a ground support equipment electrification share of 85 % of its deployed fleet and an apron tow tractor allocation of 60 units dedicated exclusively to apron service.

information_points.title: Ramp electrification charging infrastructure（CHARG）
information_points.content:
GFD-CHARG-7KF：Regarding ramp electrification charging infrastructure, TransGlobal Apron Services includes a dedicated high-power DC charging dispenser count of 8 dispensers operational within the airside maintenance depot bays.
GFD-CHARG-Q6X：Regarding ramp electrification charging infrastructure, AeroGround Ramp Logistics Consortium includes a dedicated high-power DC charging dispenser count of 12 dispensers across its airside depot bays.
GFD-CHARG-FBP：Regarding ramp electrification charging infrastructure, SkyHandling Cargo Alliance provides a dedicated high-power DC charging dispenser count of 16 dispensers at the airside maintenance depot charging bays.
